questions.prompt: The Antikythera mechanism was used to predict what?
questions.fact: Nothing of comparable gearing complexity appears again for well over a thousand years.

questions.prompt: What is the name for the point at which a liquid becomes a gas?
questions.fact: It falls with altitude, which is why cooking instructions differ at high elevation and water boils cooler on Everest.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a sport-specific term called a bogey?
questions.fact: It comes from a Victorian song about a bogeyman, adopted by golfers as the phantom opponent they were chasing.

questions.prompt: Which TV drama is set in the fictional Sterling Cooper advertising agency?
questions.fact: Its creator wrote the pilot years earlier and used it as a writing sample to get a job on The Sopranos.

questions.prompt: Which capital city sits at the mouth of the River Tagus?
questions.fact: Its lower town was rebuilt on a strict grid after 1755, using some of the earliest earthquake-resistant design in Europe.

questions.prompt: Which poem begins Let us go then, you and I?
options: The Love Song of J. Alfred Prufrock
questions.fact: Its author wrote most of it while still a student, years before it found a publisher.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the Unix operating system?
questions.fact: It began as a side project after a larger operating system was cancelled, written partly to run a game.
